one_liner: HubSpot brings together marketing, sales, service, and CRM data on a single platform.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.1 is supported via v3 endpoints along with bearer token service keys.
access_notes: Free tools and developer accounts are available with self-serve credentials.
api_notes: Covers extensive CRM v3 objects and REST endpoints at api.hubapi.com.
blocker_notes: Public APIs and self-serve developer access are fully available.

auth.quote: The new v3 OAuth endpoints provide security improvements over the previous v1 endpoints, while still maintaining the same functionality to leverage OAuth 2.1 to manage access and refresh tokens.

access.quote: Get started free with HubSpot's free tools

api.quote: If you need to set up a simple third-party integration with HubSpot or try out specific HubSpot API endpoints, you can use service keys to query HubSpot’s REST APIs directly

mcp.quote: The existing MCP functionality works in the opposite direction— allowing external AI tools to connect TO HubSpot via the @hubspot/mcp-server package.

verdict.quote: Get started free with HubSpot's free tools
